title: Restore repeated statistics-query validation
requires: macOS Apple GPU and Metal Gallery build
scope: Correct validation query-state tracking so a completed and consumed statistics query can be reset and reused by the native Metal Gallery without weakening unread or in-flight rejection.
acceptance: Repeated reset, statistics begin/end, submission, wait, result read and reuse passes through the validation layer while unread and in-flight reuse remains rejected.
The installed macOS Metal Gallery interactive smoke passes with validation enabled and proves the expected revision and direct renderer.
evidence: PASS: validation query lifecycle regression and native Metal zero-readback repeat; Apple M4/macOS 26.5.2; docs/roadmap/evidence/F3-08-query-reuse.json
